Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for ProtoFlow PCBWay Plug-In for ProtoFlow by: PCBWay Oct 20,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News ProtoFlow is an AI-assisted PCB design tool for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It brings schematic capture, PCB layout and routing, and manufacturing file exports into one workspace. Users can describe a circuit in plain language to generate an editable schematic, then review, refine, and simulate the design. ProtoFlow also supports importing from and exporting to major EDA tools. Here is the link to ProtoFlow: https://www.protoflow.ai/ We’re excited to announce that PCBWay and ProtoFlow have teamed up to make the journey from PCB design to manufacturing easier. As AI continues to transform the way we work, ProtoFlow brings AI-assisted capabilities to PCB design, helping users design, simulate, and validate their boards before manufacturing. ProtoFlow takes PCBWay’s manufacturing requirements into account during the design process and checks the board for manufacturability before export, helping users identify and address potential issues early. Its built-in simulation tools and AI agent also allow users to test designs against their own requirements and refine them until all checks pass. Once the design is ready, users can send their Gerber, BOM, and coordinate files directly to PCBWay with just one click and go straight to the quotation page. This integration creates a smoother workflow from AI-assisted design to PCB manufacturing, helping makers and engineers turn their ideas into reality with greater ease: Ready to give it a try? Explore ProtoFlow and enjoy a smoother journey from PCB design to manufacturing with PCBWay! Visit ProtoFlow: https://www.protoflow.ai/ Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac.
